filename: Technical Report_ Towards Unified Diffusion Models for Multi-Model Climate Emulation at Scale.pdf
title: Towards Unified Diffusion Models for Multi-Model Climate Emulation at Scale
testbed_rationale: No code repository or direct dataset access links are provided in this technical report.
pain_points: Simulates only a single atmospheric variable (surface temperature)
Relatively coarse spatial resolution (~250 km, 64x128 grid) missing sub-grid topography and extremes
Generates independent daily snapshots without explicitly modeling temporal autocorrelation between consecutive days
High computational cost of original multi-model CMIP6 climate ensembles
extraction_notes: The paper introduces a unified conditional diffusion model (trained with EDM) to emulate daily 2D temperature fields across nine CMIP6 models and three SSP scenarios (SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, SSP5-8.5). It also introduces paired/shared latent noise sampling to reduce variance in estimating average treatment effects.
